description.narrative: Förbättrad tillgänglighet till statistisk information i Georgien - Folkräkning 2014
Improving Statistic Data Availability in Georgia- Census 2014.

The main outcome of the project is availability of reliable population data for policy and programme planning in Georgia. This cooperation contributed to 1) GeoStat's capacity enhancement for the Census quality data collection, including gender disaggregated indicators; 2) increased population awareness on the importance of the Census and gender disaggregated population data collection; 3) Knowledge resources based on Census data analysis related to population dynamics and gender issues in support of sustainable and inclusive development are available and widely accessible. United Nations Fund for Population Activities (UNFPA) in partnership with GeoStat supported undertaking quality 2014 Census through establishing the Census data collection supervision and quality assurance system in the field and conducting multi-media campaign on the importance of Census undertaking and collection of gender disaggregated data. The Census was conducted during November 5-19, 2014 and covered whole territory of Georgia except Abkhazia, Georgia and South Ossetia, Georgia/Tskhinvali region. By 2017 UNFPA together with GeoStat developed and published four bi-lingual monographs (Geo and Engl): Young people in Georgia-An Overview Based on the 2014 General Population Census Data (Eelens, F9; Ageing and Older Persons in Georgia-An Overview Based on the 2014 General Population Census Data (De Bruijin, B. and Chitanava, M); Trends in the Sex Ration at Birth in Georgia-An Overview Based on the 2014 General Population Census Data (Guilmoto, C.Z and Tafuro, S); Population Dynamics in Georgia-An Overview Based on the 2014 Population Census Data (Hakkert, R).
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
